messages.subject: Project Indigo - Report on Title
messages.plaintextBody:
Isobel, Marcus, Priya,

Our Report on Title is attached, copied to Gavin at Pennine Business Bank. Headlines: title is good and marketable; NIY c.7.0% on the £14.25m we are now targeting; conditions to completion are discharge of the Northbank charge, your option to tax (to preserve TOGC), the Unit 6 rent deposit assignment and tenant authorities. None of the open items prevents exchange.

Happy to talk it through before the board meeting.

Sarah

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
